findings.evidence: Determinacy.lean:51 `public section`; Determinacy.lean:109-111 `E := fun _ _ _ _ => 0`; Determinacy.lean:123 `supportE := by intro i x xi t _; rfl`; Basic.lean:52-55 `structure Assumptions ... supportE : ∀ i x xi t, x < 0 ∨ 1 < x → ...`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma polynomialModel_E (p) (Flavor) (i) (x xi t) : (polynomialModel p Flavor).E i x xi t = 0 := (rfl)` and use it in `assumptions_polynomialModel.supportE` instead of `rfl` (line 123).
findings.issue: `polynomialModel`'s docstring states "its `E` is zero", but no lemma states it and the module header at line 51 is `public section` without `@[expose]` (every sibling GPD file uses `@[expose] public section`), so the body is opaque downstream. `GPD.Assumptions` only gives `E = 0` for `x < 0 ∨ 1 < x` and for `1 < |xi|` (Basic.lean:54-55), so a consumer cannot prove `(polynomialModel p Flavor).E i x xi t = 0`.

findings.evidence: grep for `zero_E` in `EpsilonEridani/` returns no hits; Ambiguity.lean:189-191 `@[simp] lemma Model.zero_H ... := rfl`; Ambiguity.lean:196-197 `supportE _ _ _ _ _ := rfl` / `skewnessBound ... := ⟨Model.zero_H ..., rfl⟩`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma Model.zero_E (Flavor) (i) (x xi t) : (Model.zero Flavor).E i x xi t = 0 := (rfl)` next to `Model.zero_H`, and use it in `supportE` and in the second component of `skewnessBound`.
findings.issue: `Model.assumptions_zero` proves its two `E` obligations with bare `rfl` (lines 196, 197) because `Model.zero_E` does not exist, while the `H` side uses the `@[simp]` lemma `Model.zero_H`. The new code itself demonstrates the gap, and the `E` component of `Model.zero` has no stated API.

summary: The new `polynomialModel` is published with an unexposed body but an incomplete characteristic API: its `E = 0` clause is documented yet unprovable downstream. The new `Model.assumptions_zero` likewise discharges its `E` obligations by bare `rfl` because the parallel `Model.zero_E` lemma is missing beside the `@[simp] Model.zero_H`.
